_note: Pre-construction interest on an own residence (S2 s.21(6); 1961 s.23(2)) is deducted in five equal instalments, within HP-OWN-RESIDENCE-INTEREST-CAP (D-156; rulebook HP-DED-PRECON-001, HP-CAP-SELFOCC-002). TY 2026-27: Income-tax Act, 2025 s.22(1)(c), (3) (Gazette 265620, pp.47–48), inside the cap by the Finance Act, 2026 s.38 (Gazette 271439, p.41); every regime, because s.202(2)(a)(v) removes only s.22(1)(b) for these properties (p.227) and the Finance Act, 2026 did not extend it (s.56 omits only s.202(2)(a)(iii), p.46) — D-156 C1(a) follows the text, against DR 06 G1.4 and DR 01 R16's new-regime example (errata there). TY 2025-26: Income-tax Act, 1961 s.24(b) Explanation, deducted "under this clause" (thc p.147), so s.115BAC(2)(i)'s disallowance of clause (b) for these properties takes it too (Gazette 244830, p.34): except in the new regime. TaxYearSpan(4) as HP-PRE-CONSTRUCTION. In every regime as a row; the new regime forbids it through DIS-NEW-TAX-REGIME-NO-EXEMPTION, whose basis REG-NEW-TAX-REGIME-NO-EXEMPTION (S2 s.202(2)(a); 1961 s.115BAC(2)(i)) every explanation cites (D-166). The row reaches the loans of a house entered as an own residence (house.occupancy = OWN_RESIDENCE; W-157, D-355).

introducedBy.instrumentCitation: Finance Act, 2023 (8 of 2023), s.52(C) — Income-tax Act, 1961 s.115BAC(2)(i) substituted (w.e.f. 1-4-2024)

provenance.sourceDescription: Income-tax Act, 1961 as on thc.nic.in (current to Act 7 of 2019), s.24(b) Explanation, p.147; Gazette CG-DL-E-31032023-244830, Finance Act, 2023 s.52(C), p.34; Income-tax Act, 1961 s.24(b) Explanation, s.115BAC(2)(i): the amending Acts from the Finance (No. 2) Act, 2019 to the Finance Act, 2026 (twelve, Gazette texts) read for it, none amends it beyond what is cited (docs/taxplanning-build/sources/2026-10-10-act-chain-2019-2026.md)

provenance.whatToCheck: Every regime is the text: s.202(2)(a)(v) names s.22(1)(b) only. No CBDT circular or FAQ was read on whether the new regime also disallows s.22(1)(c) for an own residence (incometaxindia.gov.in is not reachable from here); if one says it does, this version becomes ExceptIn NEW_TAX_REGIME.
